gui.spellcraft.help_mod_3: Every checkbox adds abyss energy per cast (+10, +12, +8, ...)
gui.spellcraft.help_mod_5: No block damage/Wider radius, Set on fire/Shove
gui.spellcraft.help_mod_6: The number input is radius, fortune level or power

gui.spellcraft.locked_scan_desc: Not learned yet. Scan a suitable block or entity with the Analyze module to unlock it forever.
gui.spellcraft.locked_toast: Module "%s" is not learned yet — scan something
gui.spellcraft.locked_unavailable_desc: This module cannot be obtained in game: it has no scan target and no prerequisite chain.

message.spellcraft.module_ambiguous: Several modules match, name one exactly:
modifier.spellcraft.area.desc: Breaks an area around the point. The number input is the radius. Conflicts with Instant mining.
modifier.spellcraft.fire.desc: Sets everything in radius on fire. Conflicts with Shove.
modifier.spellcraft.fortune.desc: Loot is rolled with fortune. The number input is the fortune level (1-5).
modifier.spellcraft.hint: You can combine checkboxes, except conflicting pairs
modifier.spellcraft.instant.desc: Breaks the whole vein at once (up to 32 blocks, 2 abyss energy each). Conflicts with By area.
modifier.spellcraft.no_blocks.desc: The explosion does not break blocks but still damages. Conflicts with Wider radius.
modifier.spellcraft.not_enough_mana: Not enough abyss energy: %s more needed
modifier.spellcraft.powerful.desc: Noticeably more power and radius. Combines with any other variant.
modifier.spellcraft.projectiles_only.des: The shield or barrier holds projectiles only, and melee damage passes through.
modifier.spellcraft.shove.desc: Shoves entities away from the epicentre. Conflicts with Set on fire.
modifier.spellcraft.silk.desc: The block itself drops, like Silk Touch. Conflicts with Fortune.
modifier.spellcraft.wait: Wait, the previous attempt is not resolved yet
modifier.spellcraft.wide.desc: Explosion radius is 1.5x bigger. Conflicts with No block damage.
module.spellcraft.abs.desc: Absolute value: makes a negative number positive.
module.spellcraft.add.desc: Adds two numbers. Inputs: two numbers. Output: the sum.
module.spellcraft.analysis_block.desc: Scans a block within 24 blocks. If a module comes from it and is not yet known, the module is unlocked for good. Output: 1 - new module unlocked, 0 - already known. Free.
module.spellcraft.analysis_mob.desc: Scans a creature within 24 blocks. If a module comes from it and is not yet known, the module is unlocked for good. Players cannot be scanned. Output: 1 - new module unlocked, 0 - already known. Free.
module.spellcraft.analysis_self.desc: Looks around the caster and finds the personal module hiding in them — the one drawn when this world was entered. It is already theirs, they just don't know which. Free, and available from the start. Returns the caster's signature number.
module.spellcraft.and.desc: Logical and: 1 if both numbers are non-zero.
module.spellcraft.arrow.desc: Launches a flaming arrow along a direction vector from the caster's eyes. A zero vector is an error. No outputs.
module.spellcraft.barrier.desc: Raises a barrier around you in a full circle, holding any damage from any direction. Costs more than Shield and takes longer to run out, because it guards your whole body rather than only the front. Input: how long the barrier lasts in ticks. Can also be put into a modular chestplate, where it stays up while the chestplate keeps running. The 'Projectiles only' modifier makes it hold projectiles and let melee damage through.
Block point the caster looks at. Shortcut for Look → Ray: block.
module.spellcraft.break_block.desc: Breaks a block and drops its loot. Unbreakable blocks (bedrock, barrier, portal frames) stay put and are reported as skipped. Inputs: point and optional number (area radius 1-6 or fortune level 1-5). Checkboxes: Area (sphere), Fortune (more drops), Silk Touch (the block itself, if your tool qualifies), Instant Mining (up to 32 connected blocks at 2 abyss energy each). Reach is 24 blocks.
module.spellcraft.caster_entity.desc: Whoever is casting. Output: entity. The start of almost any spell: position and look come from it.
module.spellcraft.clamp.desc: Clamps a number: value, min and max.
module.spellcraft.compare.desc: Compares two numbers: 1 if bigger, -1 if smaller, 0 if equal.
module.spellcraft.coord_x.desc: Takes the X coordinate of a point. Output: number.
module.spellcraft.coord_y.desc: Takes the Y coordinate of a point. Output: number.
module.spellcraft.coord_z.desc: Takes the Z coordinate of a point. Output: number.
module.spellcraft.cos.desc: Cosine of an angle in degrees. Input: degrees. Output: number from -1 to 1.
module.spellcraft.create_fire.desc: Lights fire at a point within 24 blocks of the caster. No outputs.
module.spellcraft.create_lava.desc: Places a lava source at a point within 24 blocks of the caster. No outputs.
module.spellcraft.create_water.desc: Places a water source at a point within 24 blocks of the caster. No outputs.
module.spellcraft.creative_flight.desc: Grants creative-style flight while worn and abyss energy lasts.
module.spellcraft.damage.desc: Damages an entity (at most 1000 per cast). Inputs: entity and amount. Output: the same entity, so you can pass it on, e.g. to Impulse. The target must be within 24 blocks; normal PvP and region protection rules are not bypassed.
module.spellcraft.delay_pop.desc: Takes the oldest value put aside that has waited long enough. Input: how many ticks back to look. Output: the value, or nothing if none has ripened yet — an empty output is not an error, so the module can be called every cast.
module.spellcraft.delay_push.desc: Puts a value aside for later instead of dropping it on the floor. It becomes available once the given number of ticks has passed. A spell cannot simply wait mid-cast — that would freeze the frame for everyone nearby — so a delay is a queue between casts: cast once to put it aside, cast again to take it back. Inputs: any value and how many ticks to wait.
module.spellcraft.divide.desc: Divides the first number by the second. Division by zero is an error.
module.spellcraft.drain_liquids.desc: Removes fluid sources (water, lava) in an area. Inputs: point and optional radius (0-6, at most 32 blocks per cast). Reach is 24 blocks.
module.spellcraft.duplicate.desc: Sends the input value to both outputs at once so you can wire it to two modules. The value is not consumed.
module.spellcraft.effect_desc: Applies '%s' to an entity. Inputs: entity, seconds (1-300), level (0-4). The longer it lasts and the higher the level, the more it costs. Always allowed on yourself; on others only with permission. Output: the same entity.
module.spellcraft.entities_count_in_radi: How many creatures are within a given radius of the caster. The same search as 'Entities in radius', but as a single number: useful for conditions such as 'hit only if I am surrounded'. Input: radius in blocks (defaults to 16, capped at 128).
module.spellcraft.entities_in_radius.des: Finds living creatures within a given radius of the caster and gives them out, nearest first, across four separate outputs - the rest stay empty. Wire a damage node to each output to hit several targets at once. Input 1: radius in blocks (defaults to 16, capped at 128). Input 2: how many targets to look for, from 1 to 4 - more than four cannot be returned, the module only has four outputs. The area is a true circle, not a box: radius 10 reaches exactly 10 blocks in every direction.
module.spellcraft.entities_nearby.desc: How many living entities are within 16 blocks.
module.spellcraft.entity_look.desc: Look direction of an entity. Input: entity. Output: vector — feed it into a Ray module.
module.spellcraft.entity_position.desc: Entity position as a world point. Input: entity. Output: point.
module.spellcraft.entity_under_crosshair: Living entity the caster looks at (up to 32 blocks).
module.spellcraft.equals.desc: True when the left number is exactly equal to the right one. Output: 1 for yes, 0 for no — feed it straight into a condition. Having this as its own node is what saves four nodes per comparison in a graph.
module.spellcraft.explode.desc: Explosion at a point. Inputs: point and strength (normally 0-8; Powerful pushes it to 12). Variants are toggled with checkboxes: right-click the module. Without No Blocks it breaks and ignites blocks; with it, only entities.
module.spellcraft.extract_block.desc: Draws abyss energy from a block within 24 blocks. Every block has its own price (ore costs more than stone). Repeated draws from the same spot give less and less: 100%, 50%, 33% ... down to nothing. Free. Output: abyss energy gained.
module.spellcraft.extract_mob.desc: Draws abyss energy from a creature within 24 blocks: the tougher it is, the more it gives. Repeated draws from the same target give less and less, down to nothing. Players cannot be drained. Output: abyss energy gained.
module.spellcraft.fill_region.desc: Fills the rectangle between two points with an item from the inventory. Blocks are taken one by one, so the area cannot become a source of blocks: it fills as far as your blocks last. At most 256 blocks per cast. Inputs: corner, opposite corner, item. Reach is 24 blocks.
module.spellcraft.fireball.desc: Launches a fireball along a direction vector from the caster's eyes. A zero vector is an error. No outputs.
module.spellcraft.fission.desc: Removes a block together with everything inside it, dropping nothing. Burns ALL of your abyss energy: the operation is one-shot, you cannot pay for it in instalments. Chests and furnaces vanish with their contents. Inputs: point and optional radius (0-6). Output: the same point.
module.spellcraft.freeze.desc: Holds the target still for a while: it stops moving, cannot be pushed, and cannot be knocked back. Freezing lasts for a fixed number of ticks, so a target that walks away on its own is not frozen forever. Input 1: entity. Input 2: how long, in ticks.
module.spellcraft.greater.desc: True when the left number is greater than the right one. Output: 1 for yes, 0 for no — feed it straight into a condition. Having this as its own node is what saves four nodes per comparison in a graph.
module.spellcraft.greater_or_equal.desc: True when the left number is greater than or equal to the right one. Output: 1 for yes, 0 for no — feed it straight into a condition. Having this as its own node is what saves four nodes per comparison in a graph.
module.spellcraft.heal.desc: Heals an entity by the given amount. The target must be within 24 blocks. Output: the same entity, passable onward.
module.spellcraft.heal_percent.desc: Heals a percentage of an entity's maximum health. The target must be within 24 blocks. Output: the same entity.
module.spellcraft.held_item.desc: A copy of the item in the caster's main hand. Read-only: the item stays in hand, the copy is what building uses. Output: item.
module.spellcraft.held_slot.desc: A copy of an item from an inventory slot. 1-9 are the hotbar, 10-36 the main inventory. Read-only: the item stays put, the copy is what building uses. Armour and off-hand are not read. Input: slot number. Output: item.
module.spellcraft.ignite.desc: Sets an entity on fire for the given number of seconds. The target must be within 24 blocks. Output: the same entity.
module.spellcraft.impulse.desc: Pushes an entity along a vector. The target must be within 24 blocks. A zero vector is an error. Inputs: entity and vector. Output: the same entity.
module.spellcraft.is_air.desc: 1 if there is air at the point, otherwise 0.
module.spellcraft.is_alive.desc: True if the target is a living entity and not dead or dying. Input: entity. Output: 1 or 0.
module.spellcraft.is_item.desc: True if the target is a dropped item. Input: entity. Output: 1 or 0.
module.spellcraft.is_mob.desc: True if the target is a mob. Input: entity. Output: 1 or 0.
module.spellcraft.is_player.desc: 1 if the entity is a player, otherwise 0. Great with Select.
module.spellcraft.is_projectile.desc: True if the target is a flying projectile such as an arrow or a fireball. Input: entity. Output: 1 or 0.
module.spellcraft.is_vehicle.desc: True if the target is a minecart, a boat, or a creature that carries someone. Input: entity. Output: 1 or 0.
module.spellcraft.item_count.desc: How many of that item are in the caster's inventory. Input: item. Output: number.
module.spellcraft.lerp.desc: Smooth transition between two numbers: 0 gives the first, 1 the second, 0.5 the middle. Inputs: first, second, position. Output: number.
module.spellcraft.less.desc: True when the left number is less than the right one. Output: 1 for yes, 0 for no — feed it straight into a condition. Having this as its own node is what saves four nodes per comparison in a graph.
module.spellcraft.less_or_equal.desc: True when the left number is less than or equal to the right one. Output: 1 for yes, 0 for no — feed it straight into a condition. Having this as its own node is what saves four nodes per comparison in a graph.
module.spellcraft.lightning.desc: Calls lightning at a point within 24 blocks of the caster. No outputs.
module.spellcraft.line_blocks.desc: How many block positions a segment passes through. A 10-block segment returns 11. A segment longer than 256 blocks is an error (counting billions of positions for one number is pointless). Inputs: two points. Output: number.
module.spellcraft.location_end.desc: Takes a plain point and turns it into an end address. Unlocked when you first reach the end. Input: point. Output: place.
module.spellcraft.location_here.desc: The point the caster stands at, together with their dimension. A plain point is not enough for a portal: coordinates in the overworld and in the nether are different addresses. Output: place.
module.spellcraft.location_nether.desc: Takes a plain point and turns it into a nether address. Unlocked when you first reach the nether. Coordinates are taken as-is, without the 8:1 rescale. Input: point. Output: place.
module.spellcraft.location_overworld.des: Takes a plain point and turns it into an overworld address. Input: point. Output: place.
module.spellcraft.modifier_damage.desc: Multiplies attack damage. Input: multiplier (1 = no change, 2 = double, 0.5 = half).
module.spellcraft.modifier_protection.de: Divides incoming damage by the multiplier. Input: multiplier (1 = no change, 2 = half damage).
module.spellcraft.modifier_speed.desc: Multiplies movement speed. Input: multiplier (1 = no change, 2 = twice as fast).
module.spellcraft.modulo.desc: Remainder. Division by zero is an error.
module.spellcraft.multiply.desc: Multiplies two numbers. Output: the product.
module.spellcraft.negate.desc: Flips the sign of a number.
module.spellcraft.not_equals.desc: True when the left number is not equal to the right one. Output: 1 for yes, 0 for no — feed it straight into a condition. Having this as its own node is what saves four nodes per comparison in a graph.
module.spellcraft.or.desc: Logical or: 1 if at least one number is non-zero.
module.spellcraft.percent_of.desc: Percent of a number: 200 and 15 gives 30. Inputs: number, percent.
module.spellcraft.pick_first.desc: Returns the first input value, skipping the second.
module.spellcraft.pick_second.desc: Returns the second input value, skipping the first.
module.spellcraft.place_block.desc: Places a block from the caster's inventory at a point or over an area. Blocks are consumed one by one, so the module is not a source of blocks: it places as many as you have. Inputs: point, item, optional radius (0-6, at most 16 blocks). Reach is 24 blocks.
module.spellcraft.place_held_block.desc: Places the block the caster holds, costing 1 durability. Inputs: point and optional radius (0-6, at most 16 blocks per cast). Only air or replaceable spots are filled.
module.spellcraft.point_direction.desc: Direction from the first point to the second. Inputs: two points. Output: vector.
module.spellcraft.point_distance.desc: Exact distance between two points. Inputs: two points. Output: number.
module.spellcraft.point_from_coords.desc: Builds a point from three numbers: X, Y, Z. Output: point. A point further than 24 blocks from the caster is an error: a spell cannot reach arbitrary world coordinates.
module.spellcraft.point_midpoint.desc: Middle of the segment between two points. Inputs: two points. Output: point.
module.spellcraft.point_offset.desc: Moves a point by a vector. With a number connected, the vector is scaled by it first; without one the vector is used as is. Inputs: point, vector, optional number. Output: point.
module.spellcraft.portal_gate.desc: Places two portals, entrance and exit, and links them in both directions. Compared with Teleport: you pay once and walk as often as you like. Inputs: entrance address, exit address, optional lifetime in seconds. Without a number the portal is permanent and costs three times as much. Breaking either block removes both ends. Output: the entrance address.
module.spellcraft.portal_passage.desc: Places a single portal: walk in, come out at the far end, and there is no way back. Cheaper than gates because there is one block and no second end to hunt for. Inputs: entrance address, exit address, optional lifetime in seconds. Without a number the portal is permanent and costs three times as much. Output: the entrance address.
module.spellcraft.power.desc: Raises the first number to the second.
module.spellcraft.random_range.desc: Random number between two numbers (any order).
module.spellcraft.raycast_block.desc: Finds the block along the look direction. Feed it into another module to pick the target at cast time.
module.spellcraft.raycast_entity.desc: Finds the first living entity along a direction. Input: vector. Output: entity — plug into Damage or Heal.
module.spellcraft.select.desc: If the first number is bigger than the second, takes input 3, otherwise input 4. Conditionals!
module.spellcraft.select_random.desc: Randomly picks one of two values.
module.spellcraft.shield.desc: Raises a shield in front of you for a while. It throws projectiles back at their shooter and returns melee damage to the attacker. Only what comes from the arc in front is held: a blow from behind passes through, exactly like a normal shield. Input: how long the shield lasts in ticks. The 'Projectiles only' modifier makes it hold projectiles and let melee damage through.
module.spellcraft.sign.desc: Returns -1, 0 or 1 depending on the sign.
module.spellcraft.sin.desc: Sine of an angle in degrees. Input: degrees. Output: number from -1 to 1.
module.spellcraft.sound.desc: Plays a sound, pitch taken from a number. No outputs.
module.spellcraft.sound_at.desc: Plays a sound at a point within 24 blocks; the number is the pitch (0.5-2). No outputs.
module.spellcraft.sparkle.desc: Particles at a point within 24 blocks - handy for checking where a ray hits. No outputs.
module.spellcraft.sqrt.desc: Square root. A negative number gives NaN, which then breaks every later calculation.
module.spellcraft.stack_clear_slots.desc: Frees every cell at once. Output: nothing.
module.spellcraft.stack_drop.desc: Pops the top value off the stack and returns it nowhere. An empty stack is an error. No outputs.
module.spellcraft.stack_drop_n.desc: Drops the top N values. Without a number, drops one. Input: optional number. No outputs.
module.spellcraft.stack_dup.desc: Pushes a copy of the top value without removing it, so the stack grows by one. Output: the value that was on top.
module.spellcraft.stack_exit.desc: Stops the cast early. With a condition, it stops when the value is not zero; without one it always stops. Not an error: the rest of the graph is simply skipped. Input: optional condition. Output: nothing.
module.spellcraft.stack_load.desc: Takes the value out of a cell and frees it. An empty cell is an error. Input: cell number (0-7). Output: value.
module.spellcraft.stack_pick.desc: Copies the Nth value from the top without removing it. Input: depth (1 is the top). Output: the copied value.
module.spellcraft.stack_pop.desc: Pops the top value off the stack and returns it on the output. An empty stack is an error. Output: value.
module.spellcraft.stack_push.desc: Pushes the input value onto the spell stack. The stack is separate storage: ordinary modules never push to it, only stack_* do. No outputs.
module.spellcraft.stack_repeat.desc: Pops the top value and pushes N copies in its place. A clean loop: Repeat fans the value out, Shift and Drop consume the copies one by one. Input: repeat count (0-64). Output: the value itself.
module.spellcraft.stack_size.desc: How many values the stack holds right now.
module.spellcraft.stack_skip.desc: Stops the cast when the value is zero, otherwise keeps going. Useful at the start of a loop to drop an unwanted value. Input: condition. Output: nothing.
module.spellcraft.stack_slots_used.desc: How many cells hold a value. Output: number.
module.spellcraft.stack_store.desc: Puts a value into a cell so it survives a loop. There are eight cells and an occupied one cannot be overwritten - that is an error. Inputs: value, cell number (0-7). Output: value.
module.spellcraft.stack_swap.desc: Swaps the top value with the Nth from the top without losing the ones in between. Depth 1 changes nothing; a depth larger than the stack is an error. Input: depth (1 is the top). Output: the value that was on top.
module.spellcraft.subtract.desc: Subtracts the second number from the first. Output: the difference.
module.spellcraft.swap.desc: Swaps two values. Two outputs: first whatever was on the second input, then whatever was on the first.
module.spellcraft.teleport.desc: Moves an entity to a point. The most expensive operation in the mod (150): teleporting is instant and passes through walls. Both the point and the target must be within 24 blocks of the caster. Output: the same entity.
module.spellcraft.trigger_on_hit.desc: Fires when the wearer hits an entity.
module.spellcraft.trigger_on_hurt.desc: Fires when the wearer takes damage.
module.spellcraft.unfreeze.desc: Releases a frozen target before its time runs out. Input: entity.
module.spellcraft.unique_depth.desc: Multiplies the input by how much the player has learned. A module taken in the first minute works far differently an hour later. Growth is deliberately slow and capped.
module.spellcraft.unique_eternity.desc: While the module sits in the chestplate, all incoming damage is nullified - from mobs, players, the void and starvation. Every intercepted hit costs one abyss energy, and while Eternity is active no abyss energy is gained: everything that normally refills it skips the player. Up to three players may hold Eternity at once; the rest stay unprotected. If the energy runs out, the hit that emptied it lands.
module.spellcraft.unique_eye.desc: Every abyss energy you spend from now on costs a tenth: spells, modifiers, and the modular chestplate's upkeep alike. It is not a node that does something - it is a trait. Finding it turns the discount on for good, and casting it just reports the current rate. The price of an intercepted hit under Eternity is not discounted, or immortality would become free.
module.spellcraft.unique_ledger.desc: Returns how much abyss energy the player has spent over their whole life. Useful as a threshold: compare it and branch with a condition.
module.spellcraft.unique_oath.desc: Doubles the input, burning abyss energy equal to it. The only personal module that costs anything: power is never free.
module.spellcraft.unique_resonance.desc: Multiplies the input by a personal coefficient of 1.0 to 2.0. No two players get the same, so it cannot be replaced by a plain multiplication.
module.spellcraft.unique_signature.desc: The caster's personal number. Useless on its own, but every other personal module counts from it.
module.spellcraft.vector_add.desc: Adds two vectors component-wise. Inputs: two vectors. Output: vector.
module.spellcraft.vector_angle.desc: Angle between two vectors in degrees, from 0 to 180. Inputs: two vectors. Output: number.
module.spellcraft.vector_cone.desc: Turns a vector by a random angle within plus or minus N degrees. Inputs: vector, spread in degrees. Output: vector.
module.spellcraft.vector_cross.desc: Cross product: a vector perpendicular to both inputs. Inputs: two vectors. Output: vector.
module.spellcraft.vector_distance.desc: Distance between two points in space. Saves building 'subtract' followed by 'vector length' every time a spell asks how far something is. Inputs: two vectors. Output: a number.
module.spellcraft.vector_dot.desc: Scalar product of two vectors: length x length x cos(angle). Inputs: two vectors. Output: number.
module.spellcraft.vector_flat.desc: Keeps only the horizontal part of a vector, zeroing its height. Inputs: vector. Output: vector.
module.spellcraft.vector_from_coords.des: Builds a vector from three numbers (x, y, z). Inputs: three numbers. Output: vector. Non-numeric values (division by zero, overflow) are an error, not a silent zero.
module.spellcraft.vector_length.desc: Length of a vector. Input: vector. Output: number.
module.spellcraft.vector_lerp.desc: A point on the line from the first vector to the second. With a third input of 0 you get the first point, 1 the second, 0.5 exactly halfway. Inputs: two vectors and how far along. Output: a vector.
module.spellcraft.vector_normalize.desc: Makes the vector unit length, direction preserved. A zero vector stays zero - there is nothing to normalize.
module.spellcraft.vector_rotate_pitch.de: Tilts a vector up or down by N degrees. Positive tilts down. Inputs: vector, degrees. Output: vector.
module.spellcraft.vector_rotate_yaw.desc: Turns a vector around the vertical axis by N degrees. Follows the game rule: yaw 0 looks at +Z, positive turns left. Inputs: vector, degrees. Output: vector.
module.spellcraft.vector_scale.desc: Multiplies a vector by a number. Inputs: vector, number. Output: vector.
module.spellcraft.vector_subtract.desc: Subtracts the second vector from the first, component-wise. Inputs: two vectors. Output: vector.
module.spellcraft.world_spawn.desc: The current world's spawn point (server only).
module.spellcraft.wrap_angle.desc: Wraps an angle in degrees into the range -180 to 180, so 370 becomes 10. Input: number. Output: number.
panel.spellcraft.stack_empty: Stack is empty — nothing was cast
